option.counterfactual: Local polynomial convexity of a compact smooth obstacle is sufficient for its exterior to satisfy the stated convex approximation property, despite the obstacle possibly not being globally polynomially convex.
option.approach: Search the available notes for a precise compact-locality theorem connecting local polynomial convexity to Oka complements. Verify its statement and hypotheses, since it would combine with the geometric reduction to prove every dimension belongs to S.
